questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

His mother is staring at him.

options.text: He is being stared at by his mother.
He was stared at by his mother.
He was being stared by his mother
He is stared at by his mother.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**He is being stared at by his mother.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing the given sentence into passive voice.
 
• The **subject **in the active voice becomes the **object **in the passive voice.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject "**mother**" in the active voice becomes the object in the passive voice.
 
• In the given sentence, the auxiliary verb "**is**" followed by **being**(gerund/present participle) as the sentence is in the present continuous tense.
 
• The passive voice sentence will have "i**s being**".
 
• The main verb "**staring**" will take the past participle form "**stared**" in passive voice.
 
• The **agent**(one who performs the action) in the sentence comes after the preposition "**by**" in the passive voice.

**The correct sentence is: ***He is being stared at by his mother.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
• The structure of the active voice sentence is : **subject + verb + object.**
 
• The structure of the passive voice sentence is :** object + verb + by + subject(agent).**

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The airport official said, "The daily footfall of passengers has increased significantly since last year."

options.text: The airport official said that the daily footfall of passengers has increased significantly since last year

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**The airport official said that the daily footfall of passengers had increased significantly since the previous year.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing a sentence from direct speech to indirect speech.
 
• If the reporting verb is in present tense or if we are stating a true fact, we don't need to change the tense of the sentence.
 
• In the given sentence, the reporting verb "said" is in past tense so we need to change the sentence into **past tense**.
 
• In the given sentence, the auxiliary verb **has **will change into **had **in the indirect speech.
 
• In the given sentence, "**last year**" is changed to "**previous year**" in indirect speech

**The correct indirect speech sentence is**: *The airport official said that the daily footfall of passengers **had __**increased significantly since the **previous year**.*
